changes.text: OpenAI at 1515 3rd St is now shown as announced (an October 2023 lease report) rather than open since December 2024, because the December 2024 date is only a business-registration start. Uber is shown as closed at 1515 because its FY2025 annual report gives 1725 3rd St and the building was reported leased to OpenAI in 2023; the earlier FY2022 filing is what had made it look open. The completion milestone is now 2021 (Assessor), with ArchDaily's 2022 noted, instead of June 2021; the pile-driver milestone links its SocketSite post; and the unsourced 'Uber Mission Bay 2' name was dropped from the notes.

record.notes: 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St) -- a 6-story, 302,084 sq ft office building (DataSF Assessor tax roll figures; year built 2021 per the Assessor, 2022 per ArchDaily's project page), designed by SHoP Architects and developed in a partnership between Uber and Alexandria Real Estate Equities (SocketSite, Sept 2016; ArchDaily names SHoP). Reported in October 2023 to be subleased to OpenAI along with 1455 3rd St (The Real Deal, SF Standard). Uber's FY2025 annual report (10-K) gives its principal executive offices as 1725 3rd St, not 1515.
